indicator_name: Rural population covered by at least 3G (%)
definition: Share of the rural population living in an area with at least 3G mobile coverage.
national_source_to_try_first: National telecom regulator coverage maps / NTRA, MCIT or equivalent statistical yearbook
international_fallback: ITU DataHub MOB_COV_3G via World Bank Data360 (national, proxy)
egypt_source_in_app: ITU DataHub — population covered by at least 3G (national, via World Bank Data360)

indicator_name: Mobile broadband basket price (% GNI per capita)
definition: Price of a mobile-broadband basket as a percentage of GNI per capita. Lower is better.
national_source_to_try_first: National regulator published tariff basket / NSO ICT prices
international_fallback: ITU ICT price basket via World Bank Data360
egypt_source_in_app: ITU ICT Price Basket — data-only mobile-broadband (% of GNI per capita, via World Bank Data360)

definition: Share of the rural population with access to electricity.
national_source_to_try_first: National statistical office / energy ministry rural access table

definition: Existence and operational use of a national farmer registry or equivalent producer database.
national_source_to_try_first: Ministry of agriculture farmer-registry decree, coverage report or census frame
international_fallback: No international substitute. Documentary lead only.

definition: Published interoperability standards or a data-exchange framework for agricultural data.
national_source_to_try_first: Agriculture ministry / digital authority interoperability notice or API standard
international_fallback: No scored international substitute. Documentary lead only.

definition: A data-protection or privacy law that is in force and applies to personal data, including farmer data.
Strength of the national cybersecurity legal and institutional framework, as scored by the ITU Global Cybersecurity Index.
national_source_to_try_first: National cybersecurity agency published GCI self-assessment, if any
international_fallback: ITU Global Cybersecurity Index via World Bank Data360
egypt_source_in_app: ITU Global Cybersecurity Index overall score (via World Bank Data360)

definition: A documented agricultural data-governance framework (roles, access, sharing, stewardship).
national_source_to_try_first: Ministry of agriculture or statistics office data-governance circular

indicator_name: Inter-ministerial coordination mechanism for digital agriculture
definition: A standing inter-ministerial coordination mechanism whose mandate includes digital agriculture.
national_source_to_try_first: Cabinet decree, ToR or minutes of the digital-agriculture steering body

indicator_name: Extension workers trained in digital tools (%)
definition: Share of public extension workers who have received training in digital tools, in the last max-age window.
national_source_to_try_first: Ministry of agriculture extension directorate training returns
international_fallback: No comparable global series. FAO / GFRAS notes are leads only.

indicator_name: Dedicated digital/AI units in Ministry of Agriculture
definition: A dedicated digital or AI unit inside the ministry of agriculture (or a formally mandated equivalent).
national_source_to_try_first: Ministerial organogram, establishment circular or budget line

definition: Cybersecurity controls applied to agricultural digital systems (registries, advisory, markets), not only the national GCI.
national_source_to_try_first: Agriculture-system security audit, CERT advisory or ministry CISO report
steward: Ministry of Agriculture CISO / national CERT

indicator_name: Farmer consent and data rights in AI systems
definition: Documented farmer consent and data-rights practice in agricultural AI or digital-advisory systems.
national_source_to_try_first: Consent policy, DPIA or farmer-facing terms issued by the ministry or a major public platform
